s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Battery Negative Terminal
Remove Front Door Inside Handle Bezel RH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 3 claws and remove the front door inside handle bezel RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Door Assist Grip Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 4 claws and remove the door assist grip cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Trim Board Sub-assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 screws.
Using a clip remover, disengage the 9 clips of the front door trim board RH.
Disengage the 4 claws and disconnect the front door trim board RH from the front door glass weatherstrip inner RH.
Disengage the 2 claws and remove the front door trim board RH from the front door inside handle RH.
Disconnect the connectors.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Inside Handle Sub-assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the front door lock remote control cable RH and front door inside locking cable RH, and remove the front door inside handle RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Power Window Regulator Master Switch Assembly w/ Front Armrest Base Panel Upper RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 7 claws and remove the power window regulator master switch assembly w/ front armrest base panel UPR RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Power Window Regulator Master Switch Assembly (Driver Side Door)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 screws and remove the power window regulator master switch assembly from the front armrest base panel UPR RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Power Window Regulator Switch Assembly (Front Passenger Side Door)

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, disengage the 2 claws and remove the power window regulator switch assembly from the front armrest base panel UPR LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Speaker Assembly Front NO.2

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 3 claws and remove speaker assembly FR NO.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Glass Weatherstrip Inner RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front door glass weatherstrip inner RH from the front door panel.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Speaker Assembly Front NO.1

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector.
Remove the 3 rivets and remove front speaker assembly NO.1 from the front door.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Service Hole Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector.
Remove the front door service hole cover RH.

atten3.ptxt: Remove any butyl tape remaining on the door panel side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Outer Mirror Installation Hole Cover RH
Remove Outer Rear View Mirror Assembly w/ Cover

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector.
Remove the 3 bolts and remove the outer rear view mirror assembly w/ cover.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Glass Sub-assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Connect the battery negative terminal and power window regulator master switch assembly, and move the front door glass RH to a position where the front door glass RH installation bolts are visible.
Disconnect the battery negative terminal and power window regulator master switch assembly.
Remove the 2 bolts.
Remove the front door glass RH in the order shown in the illustration.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the front door glass RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Window Regulator w/ Motor Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the power window regulator motor assembly RH connector.
Loosen the temporary bolt.

atten3.ptxt: If the temporary bolt is removed, when the other 5 bolts are removed, the front door window regulator RH may fall and become deformed.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 5 bolts and remove the front door window regulator w/ motor.
Remove the temporary bolt from the front door window regulator RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Power Window Regulator Motor Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Using a torx socket wrench T25, remove the 3 torx screws and remove the power window regulator motor assembly RH from the front door window regulator RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Stiffener Cushion NO.1

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt.
Disengage the guide and remove front door stiffener cushion No.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Door Frame Garnish RH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the clips and remove the door frame garnish RH.

atten4.ptxt: The clips will be damaged during removal, so replace them with new ones.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Glass Run RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front door glass run RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Frame Sub-assembly Rear Lower RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt.
Pull the front door frame RR LWR RH downward to remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Outside Handle Cover w/ Lock Cylinder Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the hole plug.
Using a torx socket wrench T30, remove the torx screw and remove the front door outside handle cover w/ lock cylinder assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Outside Handle Cover (Driver Side Door)

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, disengage the 2 claws and remove the front door outside handle cover from the front door lock cylinder.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Outside Handle Cover (Front Passenger Side Door)

s2.ptxt: Remove the hole plug.
Using a torx socket wrench T30, remove the torx screw and remove the front door outside handle cover.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Outside Handle Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the front door outside handle assembly RH connector.
Pull the front door outside handle assembly RH toward the rear of the vehicle to disengage it from the front outside handle frame RH.
Pull the front door outside handle assembly RH toward the outside of the vehicle and remove it from the front door outside handle frame RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Outside Handle Pad Front

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and remove the front door outside handle pad FR.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Outside Handle Pad Rear

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and remove the front door outside handle pad RR.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Lock Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Using a torx socket wrench T30, remove the 3 torx screws.
Slide the front door lock assembly RH downward, pull out the front door lock open rod RH, and remove the front door lock assembly RH.
Remove the door lock wire harness seal from the front door lock assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Lock Remote Control Cable Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front door lock remote control cable RH from the front door lock assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Inside Locking Cable Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 3 claws.
Remove the front door inside locking cable RH from the front door lock assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Outside Handle Frame Sub-assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Using a torx socket wrench T30, remove the torx screw.
Pull it toward the front of the vehicle to disengage claw (A), and remove the front door outside handle frame RH.
Disengage claw (B).
Disconnect the connector.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Lock Open Rod RH

s2.ptxt: Following the procedure shown in the illustration, disengage the front door outside handle snap and remove the front door lock open rod RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Door Electrical Key Oscillator

s2.ptxt: Remove the screw and remove the door electrical key oscillator.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Check Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 bolts and remove the front door check RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Weatherstrip RH

s2.ptxt: Using a clip remover, disengage the 16 clips and remove the front door weatherstrip RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Belt Moulding Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the body surface below the front door belt moulding assembly LH.
Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 6 claws from the inside of the door and remove the front door belt moulding assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Blackout Tape NO.1 RH

s2.ptxt: Using an infrared lamp, loosen blackout tape No.1 LH.

atten3.ptxt: Be careful of burns from the heated body or the heat of the infrared lamp.

s2.ptxt: Raise the end of blackout tape No.1 LH with a fingernail and peel it off parallel to the application surface.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Blackout Tape NO.2 RH

s2.ptxt: Using an infrared lamp, loosen blackout tape No.2 LH.

atten3.ptxt: Be careful of burns from the heated body or the heat of the infrared lamp.

s2.ptxt: Raise the end of blackout tape No.2 LH with a fingernail and peel it off parallel to the application surface.
